newsitem.title: UK: Interim Services to buy UK's Michael Page.
newsitem.headline: Interim Services to buy UK's Michael Page.

text.p: U.S. group Interim Services Inc said on Monday it planned to buy Britain's Michael Page Group Plc in a recommended cash offer valuing the recruitment firm at about 346 million pounds ($562.7 million).
The company said the deal valued each Michael Page share at 550 pence, or about 557 pence including a proposed final dividend of 7.0 pence for 1996.
Interim said the offer, including the final dividend, represented a 12.5 percent premium over Michael Page's closing share price on Friday.
"The combination creates a complementary group with virtually no geographic duplication and significant opportunities for growth," Interim Services chief executive Ray Marcy said in a statement.
The company added that its existing U.S. staffing operations would complement Michael Page's strength in Britain, continental Europe, and the Pacific Rim.
Separately, Michael Page said its pretax profits for 1996 rose 71.6 percent to 30.4 million pounds on turnover of 142.1 million pounds, up from 103.8 million pounds a year earlier.
